notes: Three branches meet at Sufyan and the names after him are written once, so they close all three routes (rule 3). The appended anecdote with «نحوه» (Muqatil b. Hayyan, Muslim b. Haytham, al-Nu'man b. Muqarrin) is left out: it is a remark on another transmission, and rule 4 does not settle whether it is a route. «- يعني ابن مهدي -» and «- واللفظ له -» are glosses and are left out.
